info.title: HERE WeGo User Service
info.description:
The HERE WeGo user service manages user entitlements and it provides role-based access control (RBAC) to those entitlements.

Error Codes:

The following common error codes apply to all endpoints.

400 Bad Request

  • E400100: Validation errors using Jakarta's ConstraintViolationException.
  • E400101: Database constraint violations using Hibernate's ConstraintViolationException.
  • E400102: Validation errors for method arguments using Spring's MethodArgumentNotValidException.
  • E400103: Errors when a required request header is missing using Spring's MissingRequestHeaderException.
  • E400104: Errors when there is a mismatch between expected and actual argument types using Spring's MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.
  • E400105: Returned when an endpoint requires a payload to be passed but none was provided.
  • E400106: Invalid update operation. The provided data does not meet the required conditions.
  • E400200: Error response from the microservice using a custom ErrorResponseException.
  • E400300: Deserialization errors due to mismatched input using Jackson's MismatchedInputException.
  • E400301: Deserialization errors due to an invalid format using Jackson's InvalidFormatException.
  • E400302: Errors when the HTTP message cannot be read or parsed during conversion in Spring using HttpMessageNotReadableException.
  • E400303: Deserialization errors due to unsupported media type being passed as a request body.
  • E400400: Exception thrown when user onboarding process fails.
  • E400401: Exception thrown when there are too many results encountered.
  • E400500: Zuora subscription is invalid.
  • E400600: Thrown when the organization lacks a HERE platform realm, which is required to complete the requested operation.

401 Unauthorized

  • E401100: Exception thrown for 'x-authorization-iam' token authorization failures
  • 400300: Invalid characters in access token.
  • 400601: Unsupported token format.
  • 400600: Expired token.
  • 401200: Authorization header missing.
  • 401201: Invalid Authorization header format, expecting Bearer format.
  • 401303: Wrong token type.
  • 401701: Access Token no longer valid.
  • 401600: No account found for given account Id.
  • 401510: User has expired.
  • 401500: User is not enabled.
  • 404660: No app exists with the given Id.
  • 401311: Requesting client status is not active.
  • 401202: Malformed OAuth 1.0 header.
  • 401204: Time stamp is outside the valid period.
  • 401205: Unsupported value for signature method.
  • 401206: Unsupported value for oauth_version parameter.
  • 401207: Nonce already consumed.
  • 401300: Invalid client credentials / signature mismatch.
  • 401310: Invalid signature.

403 Forbidden

  • E403100: Exception thrown when access to a resource or operation is denied.

404 Not Found

  • E404100: Indicates the absence of an expected entity or result, due to a missing record in the database.

410 Gone

  • E410100: Subscription has expired and cannot be used.

409 Conflict

  • E409100: Exception thrown when there are conflicting organization in feature groups.

500 Internal Server Error

  • E500100: Exception specific to PostgreSQL database operations.
  • E500101: Unexpected or exceptional condition occurred.
  • E500102: HAPI authentication error.
  • E500103: Organization not onboarded.
  • E500104: Exception thrown when tenant schema creation fails.
  • E500105: Exception thrown when BAM API call fails.
